title: Migrate App.config/Web.config settings to appsettings.json
description: Extracts <appSettings>/<connectionStrings> entries from a legacy App.config or Web.config and writes the equivalent appsettings.json structure, for use with .NET Core's Options pattern. Does not remove the original config file by default -- that is left to the operator to decide once code that reads it has also been migrated.

parameters.name: config_path
parameters.description: Path to the App.config or Web.config file to read from.

parameters.name: output_path
parameters.description: Path to write appsettings.json to (defaults to alongside the project file).

notes: If the config file contains a connection string with an embedded credential, DISCLOSE-1/SECRET-1 already forbid a phase from sending it to a model provider or including it in scope silently -- this template does not change that; a phase touching such a file still halts per DISCLOSE-1's rule, not per this template.
